text.value: Laboratory Report

tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The urine analysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, and growth of >100,000 CFU/mL Klebsiella oxytoca, indicating a urinary tract infection. Presence of hematuria and mild proteinuria are also noted. No casts or ketones detected. The low specific gravity may reflect dilute urine. Clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy are recommended.
